Ben — thanks for the draft. Quick answers: 

- Invoice recipient should be Velotech Pte Ltd (Singapore) for APAC usage; US entity for US usage. For now, route the US invoices to our US entity and APAC invoices to the Singapore entity.
- We will likely need to withhold on payments from Brazil operations (~2.5%) and India (~5%). We are confirming exact rates with local compliance but expect India withholding to apply to service fees. We will confirm with the finance team by Tuesday.

On the timing question: finance prefers invoice on signature for the onboarding fee (they want it in the same fiscal month), and monthly usage invoiced at month-end with Net 30. Is Redwood able to accept invoice-on-signature for the onboarding piece? If withholding applies, we will remit net of withholding unless we can provide a tax residency certificate — will Redwood accept a tax residency attestation and then issue a credit if withholding is later refunded?

Tom
Head of Procurement, Velotech

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Order Form: invoice triggers, withholding & tax evidence

Ben / team — looping in legal and accounting notes below.

- Invoice timing: legal is okay with invoice-on-signature for one-off onboarding fees. We need to ensure the order form states the invoice event clearly ("Invoice for Onboarding Fee: upon execution").
- Withholding: Redwood's standard position is to accept net-of-withholding payment responsibility by default and provide documentation to support reclaim when applicable. We should avoid a broad gross-up obligation — if Velotech requests gross-up, route to Sales Leadership for signoff.
- Tax residency evidence: Finance can accept tax residency certificates (e.g., Form applicable) and will process a credit/refund when refunds are received, but turnaround time can be long. Recommend offering to supply a "tax evidence pack" (certificate + Redwood statement) within 7 business days to accelerate Velotech reclaim.

Kim and Lauren, can you confirm the process below so we present the ops-friendly guidance to Velotech: 
  * Redwood issues invoice-on-signature for onboarding fee;
  * Redwood issues monthly usage invoices month-end with Net 30;
  * If Velotech withholds, they remit net-of-withholding and include withholding certificate;
  * Redwood will accept certificate and, upon final reclaim/refund, issue a credit to the customer once Redwood receives the refund.

If accepted, Ben can respond to Tom and attach the tax_residency_table.csv that maps entity -> expected WHT rates.

- Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form: invoice triggers, withholding & tax evidence

Confirming operations stance: 

- We will accept invoice-on-signature for the onboarding fee (Finance to generate invoice the same day).
- Monthly usage: bill month-end, Net 30, remit to entity indicated on invoice (Velotech SG for APAC).
- Withholding flow: customer remits net-of-withholding. Customer must attach the local withholding receipt and a tax residency certificate where available. Finance will log the withholding and open a reclaim case when/if a refund is processed by local tax authorities. Once Redwood receives the refund, we will credit the customer on the next invoice.
- Attachments for the customer: we will provide a "tax evidence pack" within 7 business days after request (tax_residency_table.csv attached).

Lauren — please keep an eye on the potential India withhold (~5%) and Brazil (~2.5%) so we can model ARR impact for the deal.

Thanks,
Kim
Director, Revenue Operations

Tom — thanks for the quick turnaround and helpful context. We can accommodate your asks. Summary and next steps below: 

Summary (what Redwood will do):
- Onboarding fee: Redwood will invoice on signature (same fiscal month as requested).
- Monthly usage: Redwood will invoice at month-end with Net 30 terms. APAC usage invoices will be issued to Velotech Pte Ltd (SG).
- Withholding: Velotech may remit net-of-withholding for Brazil/India. Please send the withholding receipts + tax residency certificates when you remit so we can log and initiate reclaim. Redwood will issue a credit back to Velotech once Redwood receives any refund from local authorities.
- Tax evidence pack: Kimberly will share Redwood's standard tax evidence pack within 7 business days after you confirm which entities will be in scope.

Open items for your confirmation (please reply):
1) Final confirmation of invoice recipient entities (Velotech SG for APAC, Velotech US for US) — if correct, we'll populate the order form accordingly.
2) Whether Velotech wants the onboarding invoice on signature (we've set to "on signature" per your ask).
3) Any requirement for a gross-up clause — absent this, Redwood will not accept a gross-up. If you need gross-up, we'll need to escalate.

If that all sounds good, I'll circulate the updated order form (clean) for signature and have finance queue the first invoice.

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
